title: TravelBuddy assistant customization example
description: One instruction/response pair for domain alignment. The shape is what scripts/assistant-align.ts formats for Nugen's benchmark upload and what scripts/assistant-eval.ts scores; the training documents in data/ai_assistant/raw are derived from the same examples, so a change to this schema is a change to both.

id.description: Stable, deterministic. Same catalogue + same generator => same id, which is what makes a re-run diffable.

instruction.description: What the traveller said. Never contains assistant text or a role marker.

context.description: Earlier turns, oldest first. Present only for multi-turn and context-carry-over examples.

grounding.description: The catalogue facts the response is allowed to state, verbatim. An empty array is meaningful: it is the 'you know nothing specific' case, and the response must say so rather than invent one.

response.description: The ideal reply. Written by hand, not generated: it is the thing the model is being taught to produce.

split.description: Assigned by the splitter, not by the author. test is disjoint from the other two and is never uploaded to Nugen.
